_about: High or critical npm advisories we have read and accept, each with why and a date to look again (ENGINEERING.md). scripts/audit-gate.mjs runs at every ship and fails on anything not listed, or listed past its date. selfcheck guards each reason that can be checked.

GHSA-3r8g-jcqq-3p5j.reason: DoS while parsing a remote functions form. Only affects apps with the experimental remote functions flag and form/query/command remote functions; this app has neither (selfcheck). Fixed only in SvelteKit 3.1.1, a major upgrade planned after the launch.

GHSA-fc5q-39xc-vjpf.reason: ReDoS on crafted glob patterns. No patched version exists. It is used only by build tools (vite, svelte-check, tinyglobby) on our own patterns at build time; nothing in the live app or the server routes passes a visitor's input to a glob.
